Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
About Us
 Panorays is dedicated to reducing supply chain cyber risk so companies worldwide can quickly and securely do business together. Our fully automated, comprehensive third-party cybersecurity solution makes security an integral driver of business growth, not just a cost of doing business. With Panorays, customers can adapt to their evolving risk landscape and scale with confidence, backed by a solution that grows with their business.
 About The Role
 The ideal Technical Support Engineer is an articulate, technically strong specialist who understands the challenges security and risk teams face in assessing and continuously monitoring their third-party ecosystem. You bring hands-on depth in web security, networking, and REST APIs, a customer-first mentality, the motivation to take the initiative to own and resolve customer issues end to end, and an interest in growing within a dynamic, fast-growing cybersecurity company.
 Work Days: Monday–Friday, U.S. business hours
 A Technical Support Engineer is the primary point of contact for all support-related issues for Panorays customers and the suppliers they assess. A TSE acts as the voice of the customer, providing technical support and best-practice guidance within our support SLAs, and works closely with Customer Success, R&D, Product Management, and Security Research.
Take end-to-end ownership of customer issues—including triage, initial troubleshooting, root-cause identification, and resolution—while serving as an internal and external point of contact to ensure issues are resolved as expediently as possible.
Meet or exceed customer expectations on response quality, timeliness of responses, and overall customer experience.
Troubleshoot customer REST API and integration issues end to end, including authentication, request construction, HTTP status codes and error responses, rate limits, pagination, and payload mismatches; reproduce calls with Postman or cURL and determine whether an issue is customer-side or a platform defect.
Validate security findings and vulnerabilities reported in the platform, including false positives, asset attribution, and scoring questions.
Review supplier disputes and conduct risk assessment checks to verify their claims, documenting the evidence behind each decision.
Support and maintain the processes and systems that associate domains and IPs with customer and supplier companies.
Check and validate new users, roles, and access levels.
Collect information and document bugs in Jira for R&D, with clear reproduction steps, customer impact, and evidence; track them to closure and keep the customer informed.
Function as a subject matter expert within support for the Panorays platform, its API, and its integrations.
Contribute to and maintain our knowledge base, security documentation, and the content that powers our AI support assistant, and promote a culture of knowledge sharing and collaboration within the team.
Stay up to date on emerging threat intelligence, industry trends, and best practices; help curate platform alerts and in-product cyber news notifications and assist Security Research in maintaining the platform’s security checks.
Push creative thinking beyond existing practices to lead process, tool, and workflow improvements that make support faster and better for customers.
Act as a customer advocate by sharing feedback and operational trends with Product Management to improve long-term supportability.
 Experience & Skills
4+ years of experience providing advanced technical support or escalation engineering for B2B SaaS solutions, preferably cybersecurity.
BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline, or relevant professional experience.
Experience working with RESTful APIs using appropriate tools (cURL, Postman, or similar), including HTTP methods and status codes, authentication (API keys, OAuth 2.0 / bearer tokens), and JSON request and response payloads.
Familiarity with networking at OSI Model Layers 3–7, and troubleshooting through use of appropriate tools (HAR captures, browser developer tools, packet captures, application logs).
Working knowledge of multi-tier database architectures, including basic NoSQL.
Strong technical capabilities in protocols and services for cloud-based platforms: TCP/IP, routing, DNS architectures, SSL/TLS and certificates/PKI, HTTP/S, and web browsers.
Strong understanding of web application security, including Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and common web vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10).
Experience with security analysis tools, including vulnerability scanners and intrusion detection/prevention systems.
High level of verbal and written communication skills in English, with excellent customer-service skills across email, live chat, and conference calls - a must.
Ability to work independently with little direct supervision and as part of a team. Excellent analytical and organizational abilities. Ability to remain calm, composed, and articulate when managing high-priority incidents and tough customer situations.
Ability to provide high-quality notes and documentation when tracking work in support and case-management systems (Intercom, Salesforce, Jira, or similar).
Experience translating customer issues into engineering-centric reports via Jira or other bug-reporting systems.
Prior experience providing support to large enterprise customers.
Willingness to work U.S. business hours - a must.
 Bonus / Preferred
Experience in third-party risk management (TPRM), GRC, or vendor risk assessment.
Experience in Security Operations (SOC), cybersecurity analysis, security assessments, vulnerability analysis, or other relevant technical cybersecurity roles.
Hands-on scripting or software development experience (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and common command-line tools.
Familiarity with SSO/federation (SAML, OIDC) and multi-factor authentication (MFA) technologies.
Experience with webhooks, OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, or integrations with GRC and ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow.
Cloud certifications (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud).
Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Cisco CCNA, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or CISSP.
